semiconductor_relevance: High — AGC provides essential materials and equipment components critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AGC specializes in providing advanced materials and equipment components for semiconductor manufacturing, including glass substrates and CMP slurries. Their offerings support various packaging processes and emphasize sustainability through fluorine material recycling.
capabilities: CMP slurry optimized for advanced packaging processes
Glass substrates with micropores for semiconductor applications
Fluororesin films and coatings for surface protection
